description_en: Queries database accounts and column encryption permissions
description_zh: 查询数据库账号和列加密权限
kebab_example: aliyun sddp list-data-asset-accounts --product-code RDS --instance-id rm-2ze1abcdefgh0000 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --auth-role fullAccess --biz-type DataMasking --product-ids 5 --account-name app_reader --lang zh --api-version 2026-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataAssetAccounts

parameters.help_en: The cloud service code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two parameters must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance ID. You can obtain this value from the Items[].InstanceId parameter in the response of the ListDataMaskingInstances operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when querying the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The column encryption access permissions. Valid values:
fullAccess: plaintext access
restrictedAccess: restricted access
noneAccess: decryption prohibited. This value applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances whose current effective key mode is client_key
parameters.help_zh: 列加密访问权限。fullAccess：明文访问；restrictedAccess：受限访问；noneAccess：禁止解密。noneAccess 仅适用于 RDS MySQL 且当前生效密钥模式为 client_key 的实例
parameters.name: auth_role

parameters.help_en: The business scenario for the query. Set this parameter to DataMasking for the column encryption scenario. Note that the value is case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh: 查询业务场景。列加密场景使用 DataMasking，注意大小写
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud service type IDs. Separate multiple values with commas (,). For the column encryption scenario, the valid values are 5 (RDS), 8 (POLARDB), and 27 (PolarDBX2)
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识列表，多个值用英文逗号分隔。列加密场景对应 5（RDS）、8（POLARDB）、27（PolarDBX2）
parameters.name: product_ids

parameters.help_en: The database account name. The system filters accounts by the exact account name
parameters.help_zh: 数据库账号名称，按完整账号名筛选
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The authentication database of the MongoDB account. This parameter is used to distinguish accounts with the same name in different authentication databases
parameters.help_zh: MongoDB 账号的认证数据库，用于区分不同认证库中的同名账号
parameters.name: auth_db

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned in the current query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

AliUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the asset belongs

AuthDb.description_en: The authentication database of the MongoDB account. This parameter must be passed together with AccountName when modifying permissions
AuthDb.description_zh: MongoDB 账号的认证数据库，修改权限时需与 AccountName 一并传入
AuthDb.title_en: MongoDB 账号的认证数据库，修改权限时需与 AccountName 一并传入
AuthDb.title_zh: MongoDB 账号的认证数据库，修改权限时需与 AccountName 一并传入

AuthRole.description_en:
The column encryption access permissions. Valid values:
fullAccess: plaintext access
restrictedAccess: restricted access
noneAccess: decryption prohibited. This value applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances whose current effective key mode is client_key
AuthRole.description_zh: 列加密访问权限。fullAccess：明文访问；restrictedAccess：受限访问；noneAccess：禁止解密。noneAccess 仅适用于 RDS MySQL 且当前生效密钥模式为 client_key 的实例

EncryptionKeyMode.description_en:
The current effective column encryption key mode. Valid values:
client_key: local key
kms_key: KMS key
This parameter is not returned if no effective configuration exists
EncryptionKeyMode.description_zh: 当前生效的列加密密钥模式。client_key：本地密钥；kms_key：KMS 密钥。没有生效配置时可不返回
EncryptionKeyMode.title_en: 当前生效的列加密密钥模式。client_key：本地密钥；kms_key：KMS Key；没有已生效的列加密配置时不返回
EncryptionKeyMode.title_zh: 当前生效的列加密密钥模式。client_key：本地密钥；kms_key：KMS Key；没有已生效的列加密配置时不返回

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the plaintext access permissions. The value is a UNIX timestamp that represents the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. This parameter is not returned if no validity period is set
ExpireTime.description_zh: 明文访问权限到期时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。未设置有效期时可不返回

Id.description_en: The database account ID. This ID is used as AccountId when configuring permissions
Id.description_zh: 数据库账号标识，配置权限时作为 AccountId 使用

ProductId.description_en: The cloud service type ID. Valid values: 5 (RDS), 8 (POLARDB), and 27 (PolarDBX2)

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the asset

RegionName.description_en: The region name of the asset

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page in the current query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to trace the current API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the current statistics or query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量
